comment: Independent allmain.c moveloop_core() witness for its "if (gw.were_changes) set_uasmon();" step. The 23:30 start on a full moon gives a human-form were a 1-in-3 chance each turn to change. A debug Priestess creates a werejackal next to her and waits with safe_wait off. Its bites lower her hit points, which hilite_status:hitpoints/down/red shows in red for up to 30 turns. When the werejackal changes into a jackal, set_uasmon() calls status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY); gu.update_all resets the temporary highlight, and the next status shows the hit points without colour.
